seconds of debt applied on hit (debt: pays whoever put it on them a letter every 10 s, commonest first; BANKRUPTCY ends it; a thing of a debtor's has no security against their creditor: shared money.ts)
seconds of curse applied on hit (curse: earns half the letters, aims worse, glum; EXORCISM, BLESSING end it: shared faith.ts)
seconds of bless applied on hit (bless: earns half again as many letters, heals a little, cheered: shared faith.ts)
seconds of expose applied on hit (expose: shown on every enemy's threat arrows wherever they are, no stealth or disguise; immune_expose also keeps letters from being read: shared signal.ts)
seconds of haste applied on hit (haste: time runs twice as fast for them: twice the speed and attacks, their other statuses wear off twice as fast; ends slow, and slow ends it: shared time.ts)
seconds of stasis applied on hit (stasis: time stops for them: they cannot move, strike or spell, nothing can hurt them, their other statuses wait: shared time.ts)
seconds of truce applied on hit (truce: untouchable and harmless: no blow lands on them and they cannot strike or spell; they may walk, gather and trade: shared sport.ts)
seconds of chaos applied on hit (chaos: a handful of their properties (speed, damage rate, armour, aim, strength, sight...) are each multiplied by a random 0.25 to 3 while it lasts: shared idea.ts)
seconds of void applied on hit (void: nothing they carry, wear, ride or stand in does anything, and their own damage, statuses and flight are nothing: shared idea.ts)

seconds of doom applied on hit (doom: a sealed fate: when it runs out the body takes three quarters of its full integrity as damage nothing resists, unless ended first (effect_status=doom): shared idea.ts)
